title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → Course
architecture_notes: Workday Student models the course catalog as Course Definitions owned by Academic Units. A Course Definition is the catalog-level template (e.g., 'CS 101 - Intro to Computer Science'); the scheduled offering is a Course Section (see course_section mapping). Equivalent to PeopleSoft's Course Catalog (CRSE_CATALOG).

source_objects.description: Catalog course: subject, number, title, description, units/credits, academic unit, grading basis. Equivalent to PS_CRSE_CATALOG + PS_CRSE_OFFER.
Subject area (e.g., CS, MATH, ENGL). Equivalent to PS_SUBJECT_TBL.
Owning department/school. Equivalent to owning PS_ACAD_ORG.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Workday supports fixed or variable units.
Map to HELIX AcademicOrg code (owning department).

attribute_mappings.source: Course Definition.Course_Level or derived from number
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX course-level terminology (undergraduate_lower, undergraduate_upper, graduate, etc.).
Map to HELIX grade-mode terminology (graded, pass_fail, audit).
Cast to ISO 8601. Workday course definitions are effective-dated.
